FAQS.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
FAQS.a: Log in to the Parent & Teacher Hub, go to Account Settings, and select Cancel Subscription. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period.

FAQS.q: How do I delete my child's data?
FAQS.a: You can remove a child profile from the Hub dashboard at any time. All associated activity data is deleted within 30 days. For full account deletion, email privacy@sodafom.com.

FAQS.q: I forgot my password — what do I do?
FAQS.a: Click "Forgot password" on the login page and we'll send a reset link to your registered email address.

FAQS.q: Can I use Sodafom in a school or classroom?
FAQS.a: Yes! Teachers can create an account and add multiple children. Contact us at support@sodafom.com for school pricing and bulk access options.

FAQS.q: The app isn't working — what should I do?
FAQS.a: Try refreshing the page or restarting the app. If the issue persists, use the contact form below with as much detail as possible (device, browser, what happened) and we'll investigate.
Sodafom starts from £1/month after a free 7-day trial. We offer monthly and annual plans — annual saves you over 30%. There are no hidden fees and you can cancel anytime.

FAQS.q: Which devices does Sodafom work on?
FAQS.a: Sodafom works on any modern device with a web browser — tablets, laptops, Chromebooks, and desktop computers. No app download is required. We recommend a screen size of at least 7 inches for the best experience.

FAQS.q: Is Sodafom aligned to the UK curriculum?
FAQS.a: Yes. Every game maps to the UK National Curriculum for Key Stages 1 and 2 (ages 5–11), with extension content for Key Stage 3 (ages 11–13). Our content is reviewed regularly to stay current.

Absolutely. Sodafom has no adverts, no in-app purchases, no social features, and no third-party tracking. We are GDPR compliant and follow COPPA guidelines. Children only interact with games — never with other users.

FAQS.q: How many children can I add to one account?
FAQS.a: You can add up to 5 child profiles on a single parent account, each with their own age group, progress tracking, and star rewards. Need more? Contact us for a family or school plan.
